messages:
Emma J: FYI customer reporting embeddings with wrong length + spikes in latency. They set x-redwood-region: ap-southeast-1 but response header shows x-served-region: eu-west-1. Trace=1950000001

Raj S: who is the customer and do we have a repro?

Emma J: Customer = GeoFinders (acct: geof-82). They sent a small curl and included trace. Repro curl from them:```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer XXX" -H "x-redwood-region: ap-southeast-1" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":["park","station"],"batch_size":64}'```

Lena P: What did they get back? dim?

Emma J: They counted 384 values and meta.embedding_dim=384. Our catalog expects 1536 for text-embedding-3-small. Also latency was 800-1.2s for some calls.

Tomas O: grabbing router logs for trace 1950000001...

Tomas O: router logs:
[router] trace=1950000001 route_attempt=1 target_region=ap-southeast-1 available_capacity=0
[router] trace=1950000001 fallback_region=eu-west-1 reason=capacity_spillover
[serving/eu-west-1] model=text-embedding-3-small-quant artifact_id=emb-small-legacy-2025-11 meta.embedding_dim=384

Raj S: That artifact_id is definitely wrong for that model. Looks like registry mapping for that region points at emb-small-legacy (384 dim) instead of emb-small-quant (1536 dim).

Lena P: Are we sure fallback should have been allowed? We shouldn't silently change output shape.

Emma J: Repro internally: I ran a burst of requests targeting ap-southeast-1 with small cluster capacity to force fallback. Simple script:```for i in {1..150}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "x-redwood-region: ap-southeast-1" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"text-embedding-3-small","input":["a","b"],"batch_size":128}' & done; wait``` Every fallback hit returned embedding_dim=384.

InfraBot: Deploy 2026-03-15T09:12:00 started 1% router canary (fallback validation)

Tomas O: Immediate mitigation proposals:
- Temporarily disable cross-region fallback for embeddings routes (fail fast)
- Add pre-fallback validation: compare registry.meta.embedding_dim of the target artifact to canonical dim and reject fallback if mismatch
- Backfill registry region mappings and add a validation on publish so 384 can't be mapped to 3-small family

Raj S: Fastest to ship is the pre-fallback dim check in the router - we can flip canary to reject mismatches. That avoids sending wrong-shaped vectors. Longer term we fix registry and CI.

Lena P: Agreed. Also we should surface a specific error code in client SDKs so customers see a clear error when region pinned can't be honored without altering shape.

Emma J: Customer comms: I told GeoFinders we identified a routing spillover and that some requests were served from a wrong artifact; apologized and offered credits. Nate approved 25% credit for the time window.

Nate (CS Lead): Priority = correctness. If fallback risks changing embedding dimension, fail the request and return clear error. Do not let silent fallback alter outputs.

InfraBot: Router canary updated: artifact-dim-check enabled at 25% 15:30 UTC. Metric exposed: router.fallback.rejected_dim_mismatch

Tomas O: RNW-9001 created to correct registry mapping in eu-west-1 for emb-small-quant (assigned to Raj). ETA 3h.

Raj S: RNW-9002 created to add publish-time CI checks that validate artifact.meta.embedding_dim vs model family canonical dim (assigned to Lena). ETA EOW.

Lena P: I'll add a unit test for fallback compatibility and an alert when a registry mapping changes for embeddings in any region.

Emma J: Action items summary:
- [Raj S] Fix registry mapping (RNW-9001) ETA 3h.
- [Tomas O] Monitor router metric router.fallback.rejected_dim_mismatch, increase canary if stable.
- [Lena P] Add CI/reg change alert + unit tests (RNW-9002).
- [Emma J] Handle final customer follow-up & apply 25% credit.

Raj S: On it. Will publish a short internal note when mapping is fixed so CS can update customer.

Emma J: Thanks all. If anyone wants my repro script/cluster emu I can drop in the support ticket 1950000001.

Nate (CS Lead): Good work. Keep transparency with customer, and don't escalate credits until mapping rollback confirmed.

InfraBot: Router canary reporting 0.4% rejected_dim_mismatch in last 10m. Monitoring.
